title: German basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken German (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/de/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Nouns are shown with their article (der, die, das) and their plural in the meaning. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
